hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let hpRate be the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction (the HP fraction of the enemy) from phase the script register's 'battlePhaseIndex'.
If hpRate is not the script register's 'battlePhaseIndex', then
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form list at hpRate's 'paramSuffixNo' on the enemy.
  Set the script register's 'battlePhaseIndex' to hpRate.
If condition flag v6 is up this frame and the enemy → is-reflected and util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "counter_firaga_probability" in aiArg, then the enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("firaga", {isCounter: true, forceTargets: [the enemy]}, {interruptCounter: true}).
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
  If the enemy → is-reflected, then set withoutAbilityList to _ → union with (withoutAbilityList, [the id of the move labelled "firaga" on the enemy, the id of the move labelled "reflect" on the enemy]).
  Let v7 be the items member in the living party where not member → is-reflected and member → is-possible-to-target.
  If not the length of v7, then set withoutAbilityList to _ → union with (withoutAbilityList, [the id of the move labelled "mustard_bomb" on the enemy]).
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "mustard_bomb" on the enemy, then
    Let v8 be _ → first with (_ → shuffle with (v7), 1).
    The enemy uses ability with options {forceTargets: v8}.
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
